name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
summary: In Darnassus, Mathrengyl Bearwalker guides Alliance druids from the Cenarion Enclave. Once Fandral Staghelm's direct assistant, he helps young druids face spiritual trials, learn shapeshifting, and serve across Kalimdor.

sections.title: Mentor of the Cenarion Enclave
sections.body: In Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave, Mathrengyl Bearwalker guides Alliance druids through their first rites. A respected elder of the Cenarion Circle, he sends initiates to commune with Moonglade and judges whether they are ready to take animal forms. Mathrengyl remembers his own bewildering communion with the Great Bear Spirit. He asks each initiate to test their spirit against Lunaclaw, the sacred moonkin, before entering the path of the Druid of the Claw.

sections.title: Service to the Archdruid
sections.body: For many years, Mathrengyl has served as Fandral Staghelm's second, tending the Cenarion Circle's daily affairs and finding recruits for the Archdruid's plans. When Fandral sought great stores of morrowgrain, Mathrengyl arranged for returning adventurers to gather it. In private, he admitted unease about the plant's unnatural essence. He also coordinates Alliance responses to calls from Moonglade and handles the Circle's delicate politics while Fandral turns his attention to southern Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Broader Perspective
sections.body: Mathrengyl thinks more openly than Fandral Staghelm, whose pride and disdain for other races are well known. Relics from Mulgris Deepriver reached Darnassus after the druid died fighting the Scourge in the Western Plaguelands. Mathrengyl was moved to learn that the investigator was a tauren. The Cenarion Circle shares a mission, he reflected, and tauren may not have strayed as far from Cenarius's teachings as Fandral claims.

faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker guides druids in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. A veteran night elf druid and respected elder, he teaches shapeshifting, poison cleansing, and service to the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: What is his relationship with Fandral Staghelm?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl served as Fandral Staghelm's direct assistant and second. He manages Fandral's requests, including gathering morrowgrain and delegating missions, while quietly doubting some of the Archdruid's views and projects.

faq.q: What forms does Mathrengyl help druids learn?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl guides young druids through their Moonglade pilgrimage and communion with Lunaclaw to earn Bear Form. He also oversees their trials in Darkshore and Westfall to master Aquatic Form.
Mathrengyl gathers morrowgrain cultivated by adventurers to help Archdruid Fandral Staghelm with botanical research on Teldrassil. He has admitted to feeling uneasy in the plant's presence.

faq.q: How does Mathrengyl feel about tauren druids?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl considers tauren druids more thoughtfully than Fandral Staghelm, who views them with skepticism. After considering a tauren druid's sacrifice against the Scourge in the Western Plaguelands, Mathrengyl said tauren may follow Cenarius's teachings more closely than Fandral allows.

faq.q: What does he do with the Nightmare Shard?
faq.answer: When adventurers bring a corrupted Nightmare Shard to Falla Sagewind, she sends them to Mathrengyl. He examines the shard with alarm and senses corruption creeping toward the Emerald Dream.

angles.text: As an Alliance druid, you can turn to Mathrengyl for guidance between Darnassus and Moonglade. He teaches Bear Form, Aquatic Form, and herbal cures for deadly poisons.
In Darnassus, Mathrengyl offers the Cenarion Circle's steady, traditional leadership. His temperate manner contrasts with Fandral Staghelm's aggressive posturing.
As a night elf, you can look to Mathrengyl as an example of Kaldorei devotion to nature and balance after the Third War, as Teldrassil grows.
